transcript.text: You mention being part of a hospital committee that reduced discharge-time delays from 4 hours to 2.5 hours. Can you describe the specific steps you took in this committee?

I'm an MBBS doctor and have worked for five years, the last three as a medical officer in a 120-bed private hospital in Ahmedabad. I cover outpatient and emergency shifts and make the monthly duty rota for eight junior doctors, though that is an informal duty. I was also part of a hospital committee that reduced the discharge delay from 4 hours to 2.5. That is when I realised how much patient experience depends on operations. I want an MBA to move into hospital management.

feedback.summary: The candidate has a solid clinical background with five years of experience and a clear motivation for moving into hospital management through an MBA due to a perceived gap in financial training. However, the responses show some inconsistency and gaps regarding their claimed management roles and contributions, including an unclear answer about formal operational leadership. Patient confidentiality constraints limit the use of detailed examples, and some answers lacked specifics on actions taken or measurable outcomes in management tasks.
